svg.title: One authority. Connected views.
svg.desc: Owner decisions enter FORGE canonical domain records, which coordinate the matching T3 provider-turn owner; AG-UI projects observed state into Chat and Node-Edge views, with scoped Context / Memory, Office / Reports, compute adapters and artifacts as supporting components.

g.data-text: FORGE owns domain records. T3 owns each provider turn.
